question.text: From the point <math><mi>P</mi><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mn>3,4</mn></mrow></mfenced></math> pair of tangents <math><mi>P</mi><mi>A</mi></math> and <math><mi>P</mi><mi>B</mi></math> are drawn to the ellipse <math><mfrac><mrow><msup><mrow><mi>x</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup></mrow><mrow><mn>16</mn></mrow></mfrac><mo>+</mo><mfrac><mrow><msup><mrow><mi>y</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup></mrow><mrow><mn>9</mn></mrow></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>.</mo></math> If <math><mi>A</mi><mi>B</mi></math> intersects <math><mi>y</mi></math>-axis at <math><mi>C</mi></math> and <math><mi>x</mi></math>-axis at <math><mi>D</mi></math>, then <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>O</mi><mi>C</mi><mo>·</mo><mi>O</mi><mi>D</mi></math><mi></mi> is equal to (where <math><mi>O</mi></math> is the origin)

solution.text:
Equation of the chord of contact of the tangents from point P to the given ellipse is 3x16+4y9=1
∴C0,94, D163,0

⇒OC×OD=94×163=12
